## Summary

Describe the package or standard change and why it is needed.

## Upstream verification

- [ ] Canonical upstream source and release were verified.
- [ ] Version and checksums agree with upstream information.
- [ ] Upstream signatures and full key fingerprints are used when available.

## Package review

- [ ] I reviewed all executable packaging files and local sources.
- [ ] `.SRCINFO` was regenerated and matches `PKGBUILD`.
- [ ] Repository validation passed.
- [ ] Clean build passed on each supported architecture.
- [ ] `namcap` findings were resolved or explained.
- [ ] Install, upgrade, removal, ownership, permissions, and primary behavior were tested.
- [ ] No package artifacts, source archives, logs, secrets, cookies, or keys are included.

## Exceptions

List any deviation from `standards/PKGBUILD/` and its compensating control. Write `None` when there are no exceptions.
